steps.description:
The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.


The Ultrasonic Sensor senses any object in front of it and returns the distance in cm. Using the LCD, display the value of the ultrasonic sensor.

1. What value do you see when you put your hand in front of the ultrasonic sensor?

2. What value do you see as you move your hand away from the ultrasonic sensor?

 

Hint:

1. Use "Create text with" block.
2. Use Forever Loop.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.


Show that your robot can make a beeping sound when an obstacle is less than 10cm away from it.

Hint:
1. The Ultrasonic Sensor senses the object in front of it and returns the distance in cm.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.


Show that your robot can make a beeping sound when an obstacle is more than 10cm away from it.

Hint:
1. The Ultrasonic Sensor senses the object in front of it and returns the distance in cm.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.


Show that your robot can make a beeping sound when an obstacle is between 31cm and 50cm (inclusive) away from it.

Hint:
1. The Ultrasonic Sensor senses the object in front of it and returns the distance in cm.

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.


Show that your robot can make different beeping sounds depending on the distance from an object.

1. When the distance is between 31cm and 50cm (inclusive), the robot makes an A4 beeping sound.

2. When the distance is between 16cm and 30cm (inclusive), the robot makes a B4 beeping sound.

3. When the distance is between 0cm and 15cm (inclusive), the robot makes a C4 beeping sound.

Hint:
1. The Ultrasonic Sensor senses the object in front of it and returns the distance in cm.
Create a flowchart of the previous step.
